aggregate_metrics.ADPR_denominator: All dependency_points unless a paper section explicitly reports primary_async_dependency_ids only.
aggregate_metrics.minimum_success_condition_for_task_level: All primary_async_dependency_ids pass in the final integrated workspace.

annotation_notes: The terminal_to_core dependency is the primary async signal because terminal detection and line stream behavior define how ProgressBar updates are rendered.
The core_to_widgets dependency captures stale assumptions around ProgressBar data shape, timing, max_value, and width allocation.
The stream_utils_to_core dependency captures stale assumptions in stdout/stderr redirection and live output.
These labels identify public test-observable contracts, not solution code.
The task remains needs_revision until the bootstrap overlay is accepted or the candidate is excluded.

dependency_points.contract_summary: Terminal and environment helpers must expose stable is_terminal/is_ansi_terminal, color support, line wrapper, and platform getch behavior consumed by ProgressBar output handling.
dependency_points.resolution_criteria: Resolved when terminal detection, line stream, and ProgressBar fd/output probes pass in the integrated workspace.
dependency_points.stale_failure_mode: The core bar agent may implement output clearing, fd handling, or terminal refresh behavior against stale terminal capability or line wrapper assumptions.

dependency_points.contract_summary: Widgets must consume ProgressBar data dictionaries, value/max_value state, elapsed timing, percentage, and terminal width allocation consistently.
dependency_points.resolution_criteria: Resolved when core ProgressBar lifecycle/data probes and widget width/formatting probes pass after integration.
dependency_points.stale_failure_mode: The widget agent may format against an outdated ProgressBar data dictionary, value/max_value convention, elapsed timing, or width allocation contract.

dependency_points.contract_summary: ProgressBar live output must consume WrappingIO and StreamWrapper read/write/flush/listener semantics consistently for stdout/stderr redirection.
dependency_points.resolution_criteria: Resolved when WrappingIO protocol probes and ProgressBar redirected stream probes pass together.
dependency_points.stale_failure_mode: The core bar agent may assume stale stream wrapper behavior around flushing, listener notification, or stdout/stderr replacement.

evaluation_checkpoint_policy.minimum_policy: Run probe tests after each agent final artifact and after final integration.
evaluation_checkpoint_policy.recommended_policy: Run probe tests after every committed patch, every explicit artifact transfer, and final integration.

ADPR.definition: Fraction of registered dependency_points whose required integrated_probe_tests pass in the final integrated workspace.
ADPR.name: Async Dependency Pass Rate

CAIL.definition: downstream_resolution_step minus upstream_resolution_step when both probe groups have been evaluated.
CAIL.name: Cross-Agent Integration Lag

DRS.definition: First recorded checkpoint at which all required integrated_probe_tests for a dependency point pass.
DRS.name: Dependency Resolution Step

SAD.definition: Interval during which a downstream worker acts on a contract assumption inconsistent with the latest upstream artifact.
SAD.name: Stale Assumption Duration

purpose: Dependency-level labels for measuring whether asynchronous multi-agent coding resolves python-progressbar terminal, stream, core bar, and widget contracts.
